race.description: Ladbrokes Odds Surge F&M Mdn Hcp
race.comment: LEAVES OF LORIEN (1) is hard to ignore fresh, bringing black-type exposure and a strong third here behind dual G1-winner Warwoven at the start of the year. Has trialled like a bomb in readiness and gets in a treat at the weights with the 3kg claimer engaged. Expecting her to take plenty of stitching. STELLAGRACIA (4) made an encouraging debut at Doomben last month behind what looks a smart one, then can be completely forgiven last start when finishing down the track, with the mare revealing a slow recovery and coughing. Thompson sticks and if she's on-song she's a massive threat. RECONCILIATE (6) had been building nicely before an excusable effort here last time when wide throughout on a wet deck. Blinkers go on first time and a 3kg claimer jumps aboard to get her in light. Can rebound sharply. CLOUDED THOUGHTS (7) didn't have much luck getting clear in the straight on debut at the Gold Coast but let down strongly once ducking back to the inside. Plenty of improvement to come.
